messages:
mia: quick sync — FP8 canary on H100 (multi-model pool) finished. seeing a small but consistent ROUGE drop on summarization tests vs FP16, ~1.8 pts on longdocs. ran AWQ and GPTQ variants as well.
raj: can you paste the exact config used for the canary? batch sizes / max_seq / enable_kv_cache?
mia: config snippet:
```
model: atlas-20b
device: h100
precision: fp8
autoscale: disabled
batch_size: 4
max_seq: 4096
enable_kv_cache: true
quant_backend: awq
```
oliver: interesting — we saw similar ROUGE deltas on L40S but only when we had aggressive prefix caching + eviction. could be related to per-layer scale accumulation in FP8 during incremental decode.
eva: profiler traces? any NaNs or saturation counters?
mia: no NaNs. saturation counter bumps on a few attention heads during long prefixes. attached trace: head_3 saturations spike around token 1800.
raj: could be a scaler underflow/overflow versus activation clipping mismatch between training-time stats and runtime scaled kernels. did you try switching to the compat fp8 shim?
mia: yes — shim (compat-mode) removed the ROUGE gap but hurt latency by ~12%. shim also disabled continuous batching heuristics so throughput dropped.
oliver: notes from runtime team: H100 kernels use shared exponent packing that is sensitive to KV eviction ordering. if eviction causes non-monotonic prefix lengths, the scale recalc path can introduce tiny bias. accumulates over long prefixes.
eva: experiment idea: run FP8 AWQ with kv_cache disabled and keep same seq distribution; if gap disappears -> eviction interaction.
mia: queued that test. also ran GPTQ INT8 fallback on same dataset — INT8 had no ROUGE regression but higher latency compared to AWQ-FP8.
raj: also check mixed-precision path where attention matmul uses FP8 but residual/add uses FP16 — boundary casts can introduce small rounding that amplifies over many steps. add a toggle to force all-reduce to FP16 to see effect.
mia: ack. planning a 6-hour shadow run with three arms: (1) FP8-AWQ-kv_enabled, (2) FP8-AWQ-kv_disabled, (3) FP16 baseline. will push canary config at 18:00 PT.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @mia for 3076546100 to pool:gpt-inference-canary, replicas:3, env:canary
oliver: add metric hooks: per-head saturation, prefix-length vs delta-rouge, and a per-token relative perplexity metric. also log per-request route (hot vs cold cache).
eva: also capture model logits diff snapshots for 100 sample prompts at checkpoints. that helps pinpoint layer where drift starts.
raj: good. if FP8 remains worse but only on longdoc workloads we might consider route policy: stick FP16 for requests with prefix>1024 and FP8 otherwise. tradeoff for cost vs quality.
mia: noted. I'll post results once run finishes. thanks all :thumbsup:
